hidden_factors: Confidence and candidate-union logarithms are the factors hidden by the theorem's tilde notation.

all_eligible_times.basis: TV telescoping over at most one epoch
all_eligible_times.statement: for T=Omega_tilde(Delta^(-2/3)), between-boundary transfer adds O(Delta^(1/3))

gradient_bound.basis: ||x||=1 and the numerator is in [-2,2] while max{|w dot x|,gamma}>=gamma

independent_selection.basis: candidate iterates depend only on the first half; Hoeffding plus a union bound applies on the independent second half, followed by TV transfer to epoch end
independent_selection.statement: the second half selects an iterate within O_tilde(Delta^(1/3)) of the best final-time risk

iterate_existence.basis: minimum excess is at most average excess
iterate_existence.statement: some first-half iterate has error eta+O_tilde(Delta^(1/3)/gamma)

projected_regret.basis: projection nonexpansivity, telescoping potential, and Azuma-Hoeffding for the bounded martingale differences
projected_regret.statement: average population gradient regret <=O(1/(gamma sqrt(m))) with high probability

regret_to_error.basis: four sign/margin cases; on points where current and final targets agree and the final margin is at least gamma the inequality is pointwise, while the weighted exceptional terms are bounded by the joint-TV drift via its dual form

runtime.basis: W projected d-dimensional updates and at most W^2 candidate-validation evaluations per epoch

success_probability.basis: allocate failure probability 1/20 to martingale control and 1/20 to validation; union bound gives 9/10

source_repairs: Read the undefined update symbol g_t as the gradient g defined one line earlier.
Apply Azuma-Hoeffding to lambda*sum xi with an explicit lambda; the source's exponential-moment display omits lambda.
Use the two-sided Hoeffding bound with log(W/delta) and allocate the two 1/20 failure events explicitly.
Use consistent epoch and validation indices.
